statement: Gaia DR3 stars with RUWE below 1.4, a parallax more than 10 times its error and a radial velocity (cuts made upstream of the pack, so they remove 0 of its 1570 rows).

Two strata, a random subset of each: parallax above 10 mas (closer than 100 pc), about 1 in 273 of the 133,468 that pass (489 in the pack); parallax 1 to 10 mas (100 pc to 1 kpc), about 1 in 9,065 of the 9,798,805 (1081 in the pack). The near stratum is over-sampled on purpose.
A radial velocity needs a bright star (G_RVS below about 14): the sample is not complete in distance and holds more bright, nearby stars than the sky does.
The Oort contract keeps stars nearer than 1 kpc by the catalogue parallax: 1570 stars.

alone.label: distance limit (the method is first order in distance)

steps.label: distance limit (the method is first order in distance)

strata.label: parallax 1 to 10 mas (100 pc to 1 kpc)
